page: Microsoft Azure E4as_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine built on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance features 4 vCPUs mapped across 2 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading (2 threads per core) on a dedicated AMD EPYC 9V74 processor running at 3.7 GHz. The x86_64 processor configuration provides 32 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache, with hardware instruction support for AVX-512 (including VNNI and BF16), AES, VAES, and SHA-NI cryptographic operations. Memory capacity is allocated at 32.0 GB of RAM, establishing a 1:8 vCPU-to-memory ratio (8.0 GB per core). This instance includes no dedicated graphics hardware (0 GPUs) and does not bundle local disk storage, relying on external Premium Storage attachment.

Benchmark evaluations reveal strong single-thread compute capabilities, demonstrated by a stress-ng single-core score of 3066.27 and a Geekbench single-core result of 2000.0, both placing in the top 25%. Multi-core performance is moderate, reflecting its 2-core / 4-vCPU topology, yielding a stress-ng multi-core score of 6100.57 and a PassMark CPU score of 7531.84. In data-handling tests, the VM delivers average throughput for gzip compression (29.34 GB/sec) and static web serving (6.57 GB/sec). Memory throughput tests present lower comparative figures, with large-block uncached read bandwidth reaching 37.9 GB/sec and write bandwidth reaching 28.01 GB/sec. Similarly, high-frequency transactional benchmarks such as Redis SET operations (5.84 million operations/sec) and PassMark database operations register in the lower 25% bracket.

The hardware configuration provides high memory density per core, making the E4as_v6 cost-effective for tasks requiring extensive working sets without the overhead of higher vCPU counts. Because local ephemeral disks are absent, input/output requirements must be fulfilled via network-attached storage. The instance is suited for in-memory enterprise applications, mid-sized caching layers, analytical ETL staging, and memory-bound backend services.
